name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text field for longer input such as comments or descriptions. Set `autoResize` to grow its height with the content. Renders a `<textarea>` element.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grows the textarea's height to fit its content as the user types, and turns off manual resizing.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the textarea as invalid, applying error styles. Sets `aria-invalid` on the `<textarea>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the textarea, controlling padding and typography.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text in the field. Use when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the text changes as the user types, pastes, or deletes. Receives the new text and the change event details. Not called while `disabled` or `readOnly` is set.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text in the field. Use when controlled.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Textarea.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
